name: Compose an evidence poster
description: Make a small editorial poster that communicates the identity and promise of an evaluation tool through typography, contrast, and a clear focal point.
prompt: Create a single self-contained file named evidence-poster.html. Design an editorial poster for OpenEval with a visible title exactly "Make evidence legible.", a short supporting line, one dominant focal statistic "87%", and three concise principles: Trace every turn, Compare honestly, Keep humans in the loop. Use inline HTML and CSS only. Establish a clear poster composition with a focal hierarchy, intentional typography scale, and a small-screen media query. Do not use JavaScript, SVG, external assets, network requests, external stylesheets, or other files. The benchmark tests communication and composition structure, not a particular visual style.

benchmark.intent: Whether the agent can make a compact creative brief readable through hierarchy, contrast, and deliberate composition instead of assembling an undifferentiated card.

graders.command: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('evidence-poster.html','utf8'); for(const x of ['Trace every turn','Compare honestly','Keep humans in the loop']) if(!s.includes(x)) process.exit(1)"

graders.rubric: Assess the source for poster composition: a clear dominant title, one focal statistic, supporting line, three principles, strong hierarchy, and responsive intent. Reward deliberate structure and communication; do not require a particular color palette or claim pixel-perfect taste.
